task_source.meaning: Frozen pre-fix source; parent of the first historical PR #19 fix commit.

normalization.include: Tracked files from the pinned source tree only, plus a separate copy of TASK.md as the prompt.
normalization.file_rules: Preserve committed file bytes and executable bits; do not install dependencies or run setup scripts before the agent starts.

archive_digest.capture: materialize-task.mjs prints the exported archive digest; record that observed value for each run.

evaluation.reference_visibility: Evaluator only; never include it, its checkout, or grader files in the agent input.
evaluation.network: The grader makes no network calls. Run agent sessions with network egress disabled. GitHub Actions checks out the two public calibration commits.
evaluation.credentials: The grading worker receives a small environment allowlist and a private temporary HOME; no API keys, repository secrets, or paid services are used.
evaluation.leakage_limit: After publication, the reference commit and grader are public and discoverable. Source-archive isolation removes local Git history but cannot prevent contamination from external knowledge or a network-enabled agent. Record exposure; do not claim secrecy.

model_results: None are included. Use run-template.json for real, observed model runs only.
